question: which frozen FlexiCT layer and field of view give the best LUNA25 development discrimination with the project's max head, before FlexiCT enters the SAE exploration

two_field.rule: max head over the concatenated final-layer tokens of the 72 mm reference view and the 50 mm local view of the baseline suite (216 + 216 tokens)

field_rule: provider-centred physical crop, 48^3 tensor (patch 8, 6^3 tokens), spacing = field / 48 (0.83, 1.04 and 1.33 mm), HU clipped to [-1000, 1000] and z-scored over the field, as in the baseline suite
layer_rule: patch tokens after block b of 16 with the final norm applied (official get_intermediate_layers)
head: max
selection: each candidate (field, block) is fitted with seed 2025 at both learning rates and scored by its better development AUROC (log-loss tie break); the best candidate is repeated with seeds 2026 and 2027 and replaces the baseline selection only if its three-seed mean AUROC is higher
